# uzc_networks (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud networks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_networks" "all" {
  cloud_provider = "nimbo"
  type           = "Isolated"
}

output "network_slugs" {
  value = [for n in data.uzc_networks.all.networks : n.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cloud_provider` (String) Filter by cloud provider slug.
- `type` (String) Filter by network type (e.g. "Isolated", "L2").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `networks` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))
